newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to reach higher, test 101.02.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to reach higher, test 101.02.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will push higher on Wednesday, but will soon encounter a band of resistance at 100.99 to 101.02, technical analysts said.
If they manage to vault this barrier, they have the scope to extend gains to the 101.14, 17 resistance area, they added.
"For today I'm rather bullish, but the first resistance area is pretty near by," said ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett technical analyst Geert-Jan Nikken in Amsterdam.
By 0658 GMT the June Bund was up 18 basis points at 100.86.
Nikken said Tuesday's test of the upward sloping trend channel meant investors could focus on the upside once again.
He put first resistance at an area of congestion at 100.99 to 101.02. Charts show the market hit a low of 100.02 on April 10, and April 15 and a high of 100.01 on April 14.
"Above there we've got 101.14 to 101.17 then we can focus on 101.58, the upper band of the trend channel," said Nikken.
The June Bund hit a daily high of 101.14 on April 17.
On the downside, Nikken said the market should have little trouble staying above 100.31.
"I doubt if we'll see that today, but if it does take out that area, then we'll see a pick up in momentum on the downside," he said, targeting 99.70, the low from April 14.

DKB International technical analyst Donna Liu also expected Bunds to push higher short term, citing 101.02 as the initial target. "If we go to there the upside should extend further to 101.10 and then 101.25," she told RFTV.

Analysts at a European bank here were similarly optimistic. "So far the reverse head and shoulders pattern still looks bullish," they said in a morning note. "Once 101.12,13 is overcome the way is clear for a push to 101.60."
By 0811 GMT the June Euromark contract was unchanged at 96.75, just off near term resistance at 96.78.
